MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.Telephony.PhoneStateListenerFlags ActiveDataSubscriptionIdChange = int32(4194304)
ActiveDataSubscriptionIdChange = 4194304

summary.para: The corresponding Android constant was deprecated in API level 31. Use instead.

Listen for changes to the active data subscription ID. The active data subscription is used to set up cellular Internet data. For example, it can be an active opportunistic subscription or the subscription selected as the default for data in dual-SIM mode. On Android 12 or later, apps that target Android 12 or later require or carrier privileges for this event.

BarringInfo = -2147483648

summary.para: The corresponding Android constant was deprecated in API level 31. Use instead.

Listen for barring information for the registered or camped cell. This event requires or carrier privileges. On Android 11 through 13, apps targeting API level 29 or later also need ; older target versions are checked for . Carrier privileges do not replace the location requirement.
